asset.description: Indoor cannabis cultivation — vegetative stage weeks 3–5 (extended 5-day monitoring arc)

phases.name: baseline_stable
phases.description: Weeks 3–4 vegetative stage, nominal operation. Two full light/dark cycles establish a solid structural baseline across all 8 sensors.

phases.name: night_cycle_recovery
phases.description: Overnight lights-off period: CO₂ rises, temperature drops, humidity climbs. Dawn transition and morning ramp-up confirm healthy baseline recovery.

phases.name: hvac_degradation
phases.description: HVAC underperformance begins. Supply temperature creeping up, reduced fresh-air exchange lowering CO₂. Structural fingerprint begins diverging from baseline — risk transitions to MEDIUM.

phases.name: heat_stress_buildup
phases.description: Temperature approaches and breaches 85 °F. VPD climbs above 1.6 kPa — plant transpiration stress. Structural instability rises sharply. Alert: HIGH risk trending.

phases.name: critical_alert
phases.description: CRITICAL: Canopy temperature 88–92 °F. VPD exceeds 2.0 kPa — severe transpiration stress. CO₂ depleted to ~900 ppm. EC climbing (concentrated nutrient solution). Structural geometry shows full collapse signal. Immediate intervention required.

phases.name: operator_intervention
phases.description: Operator response: HVAC set-point corrected to 72 °F, reservoir flushed and pH adjusted, CO₂ enrichment boosted to 1600 ppm target. Temperature descending, VPD collapsing. System re-entering acceptable envelope.

phases.name: recovery_stabilization
phases.description: System fully recovered. Temperature 76–78 °F, VPD 0.85–1.0 kPa, CO₂ back to 1380 ppm. Structural geometry converging back toward baseline fingerprint. Risk returns to LOW. New baseline event recorded in memory.
